title: Vyshka envelopes and the poll exchange
description: Machine-readable companion to spec/protocol.md sections 3.1.2, 4 and 9. The prose document is normative: where the two disagree, the prose wins. This document defines no root constraint of its own: it is a library of definitions, referenced as `envelopes.schema.json#/$defs/envelope` and so on, because the three shapes here travel in different places and validating them against a single root would only be a way to accept all three everywhere.

seq.description: Per-session, per-direction sequence number. Starts at 1 and increases by one per envelope.

ack.description: Highest contiguous seq the sender of this field has durably processed. 0 acks nothing.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 with a UTC offset. The time the message was created, not the time it was last sent. A receiver substitutes its own receipt time rather than reject an envelope whose ts is missing or unparseable.

envelope.title: Envelope
envelope.description: The framed message unit exchanged between plugin and hub, in both directions and over both transports.
envelope.comment: A sender must emit all of id, type, seq and ts. A receiver refuses an envelope missing id, type or seq, but never refuses one over ts alone: it substitutes its own receipt time. This schema states the sender's obligation.

v.description: Envelope version. Required from the hub, optional from a plugin, where absence means the session's negotiated envelopeVersion. Bumps only on envelope-breaking changes.

id.description: Unique per message and stable across retransmissions. ULID in this protocol's own implementations.

type.description: Namespaced message type. Unknown values are acked and ignored, never fatal.

body.description: Type-specific payload. Body-level evolution is additive: receivers must ignore unknown fields.

pollRequest.title: Poll request
pollRequest.description: Body of POST /plugin/v1/poll. Every field is optional: {} is a valid idle poll.

envelopes.description: Envelopes the plugin is sending, in ascending seq order. A hub accepts at least 200 per request.

pollResponse.title: Poll response
pollResponse.description: Body of a 200 answer to POST /plugin/v1/poll.

envelopes.description: Envelopes queued for the plugin, in ascending seq order. Always present; an empty batch is [], never null.

pollTimeoutSeconds.description: Effective hold time for this session, repeated so a plugin never has to cache it.
